d: Deep navy blue hair is styled with long, flowing locks, thick bangs, and a white floral hairpiece. Deep navy blue eyes have a soft, gentle expression on a youthful, mature face. The build is slender and lithe, dressed in a white one-shoulder dress with a deep navy blue lining and a matching flowing capelet, paired with white calf-high boots and a small brown leather hip pouch. Signature details include a long black spear adorned with white lilies and small green spherical creatures perched on the head and floating nearby.
